```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Government and government intervention in the economy were blamed for the nation’s ills, ironically.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Right-wing ideologues exalted private services and private charities while debasing government as inefficient provision for the undeserving.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The ideological totem of “Reaganomics” still stands today.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Schools, city services, prisons, and even armies operated by private entities are considered better run because they are in private hands.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The underfunded postal service—and not the Enron collapse, the savings and loan scandal, or private Blackwater thugs in Iraq—has become the poster child for waste and incompetence.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The devaluing of the public sector has harsh real-world consequences.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The response to Hurricane Katrina was pathetic.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Bush administration had scandals, including the maltreatment of veterans at Walter Reed Hospital.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Interest-rate spiking and foreclosures followed from the unregulated and flagrant predatory lending of subprime rate mortgages.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Foreclosures are hitting low-income communities of color particularly hard.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Foreclosures and interest-rate spiking are a direct outcome of the wholesale privatization of inherently governmental functions and the deflection of resources to serve corporate interests rather than socially determined national security needs.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
